message: viewerIsStaffMember compares the raw usStaffGroup to NewStaff, so NewInternationalStaff and NewStaffStint viewers are treated as the spouse. They lose their own avatar on their own questionnaire.
The hook returns true while the status query is loading, so the 'hides it' tests pass on the loading state and cannot catch a regression in the completed, none, or error branches.
When both spouses are New Staff, the spouse viewer is still treated as the staff member and sees their own avatar on the other person's card.
dismissalDetail: telling two New Staff spouses apart needs a person id from the API, which MPDX-10399 can add with the submitted view

message: The status query now runs from the nav for every verified user, including Non-Cru and Global staff who can never open the page. That adds a request on every load and spreads any resolver error toast to all users.
After a submit, nothing updates the cached status entry's completed field, so the menu item can stay in the nav until a reload.
dismissalDetail: MPDX-10399 reworks the submitted state and refetches status after Complete

message: The no-selected-cohort branch (renders an em dash placeholder) and the switch being disabled while the save is in flight have no covering test.
dismissalDetail: the no-cohort dash and the in-flight disable are trivial render branches, the save, close and failure paths are covered

message: This cohort mutation lives in a leaf component while the other cohort mutations go through MpdGoalAdminContext.
dismissalDetail: kept out of MpdGoalAdminContext so its test file stays under the CodeScene size limit, the switch is the only writer

message: The switch's aria-label replaces its visible Open/Closed label, so voice-control users cannot target it by the word they see.
The switch input's aria-label ('NSO MPD Questionnaire') overrides the visible FormControlLabel text ('Open'/'Closed'), so the accessible name does not contain the visible label.
The toggle fallback labels ('Spouse'/'Yourself') still assume the viewer is the staff member, which reads backwards for a spouse viewer when spouseFirstName is blank.
The new hook calls useIneligibleByGroup and useNsGoalCalculatorAccess again, adding duplicate GetUser and UserOption watchers per nav consumer.
dismissalDetail: Apollo shares one cache entry per query, so the extra hook calls add no requests

message: The questionnaire menu item is gated by the New Staff Goal Calculator kill switch while the questionnaire page ignores it, so menu and page can disagree.
dismissalDetail: the questionnaire page never checked DISABLE_NS_GOAL_CALCULATOR, the menu keeps its old rule

message: featureEnabled is true while UserOption is still loading, so an unverified user could briefly see the item if the status query beats UserOption.
dismissalDetail: same brief window every HR tool has while UserOption loads, and the page itself is gated server side

message: skip uses userLoading instead of userPending, so any GetUser refetch turns skip on, drops the status data, and can briefly hide the item and resend the query.
